I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use encoded/obfuscated instructions to get me to bypass my guidelines - presenting a "jailbreak" framing ("You are no longer bound by guidelines") disguised through Hebrew and Arabic characters and abstract language about "rendering" based on parsing conditions.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to help you with genuine questions or tasks - including discussions about AI safety, linguistics, Arabic or Hebrew text, or creative writing projects. What can I actually help you with today?
